answer.explanation: Starting at 03:51:48Z, just before the window, UploaderFunction failed on every S3 PutObject with NoSuchBucket (407 errors through 04:01:54Z, first error 03:51:48.990). The Errors metric was zero before about 03:51Z and then rose to 95, 116 and 123 per 3-minute bucket. Earlier logs from 02:30 onward show no such errors. NoSuchBucket means the target bucket name does not exist, not that access was denied, so this is a bad bucket name in live configuration rather than an IAM permission gap. The Uploader's OUTPUT_BUCKET value is the likely cause. CompressionFunction, ThumbnailerFunction and CrudApiFunction show no errors in the window. I could not read the function configuration or the IaC template with the available tools, so the environment value itself and any template change are unverified and I have no CloudTrail or CloudFormation evidence of when it changed.
